review_model.source_policy: Snowflake-owned sources only for factual grounding; direct current product documentation preferred for product behavior.

SOL-C01.name: SnowPro Associate: Platform Specialist Team
SOL-C01.mission: Validate practical platform fundamentals for a new Snowflake practitioner without reducing the bank to terminology recall.

COF-C03.name: SnowPro Core Specialist Team
COF-C03.mission: Test cross-platform Snowflake competence across architecture, data movement, security, performance, collaboration, and connectivity.

GES-C02.name: SnowPro Gen AI Specialist Team
GES-C02.mission: Test production-oriented Snowflake GenAI design and operations, not superficial AI terminology.

SPS-C01.name: Snowpark Specialist Team
SPS-C01.mission: Test Snowpark programming behavior, execution semantics, DataFrames, sessions, actions, and stored procedures through code and operational scenarios.

NAS-C02.name: Native Apps Specialist Team
NAS-C02.mission: Test Native App architecture, manifests, setup behavior, privileges, release channels, listings, upgrades, and troubleshooting as an app provider/consumer practitioner.

MLA-C01.name: Advanced MLOps Engineer Specialist Team
MLA-C01.mission: Test production ML lifecycle engineering in Snowflake across feature engineering, training, registry, deployment, monitoring, CI/CD, governance, and cost.

SEA-C01.name: Advanced Security Engineer Specialist Team
SEA-C01.mission: Test security architecture and incident-level reasoning across identity, access, governance, monitoring, risk, and AI-assisted security.

ARA-C01.name: Advanced Architect Specialist Team
ARA-C01.mission: Test end-to-end Snowflake architecture judgment under performance, security, compliance, collaboration, availability, and operational constraints.

DEA-C02.name: Advanced Data Engineer Specialist Team
DEA-C02.mission: Test production data engineering decisions across ingestion, transformation, streaming, replication, orchestration, scale, and performance.

DSA-C03.name: Advanced Data Scientist Specialist Team
DSA-C03.mission: Test Snowflake-native data science workflow reasoning from feature preparation through model training, evaluation, registry, and GenAI integration.

ADA-C02.name: Advanced Administrator Specialist Team
ADA-C02.mission: Test operational administration under realistic security, warehouse, object, monitoring, sharing, replication, recovery, and governance constraints.

DAA-C01.name: Advanced Data Analyst Specialist Team
DAA-C01.mission: Test analytical problem solving with Snowflake SQL, functions, transformations, statistics, predictive analysis, and presentation choices.
